verses.geez: መዳልወ፡ ዓመፃ፡ ርኩስ፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ መዳልወ፡ ጻድቅሰ፡ ኅሩይ፡ ውእቱ።
verses.translation: False balances are an abomination before the Lord: but a just weight is acceptable unto him.

translations.lxx: False balances are an abomination before the Lord: but a just weight is acceptable unto him.
translations.kjv: A false balance is abomination to the LORD: but a just weight is his delight.
translations.ron: Cântarul strâmb este urgisit de Domnul, şi cântărirea dreaptă este plăcerea Lui.
translations.grk: Ζυγοί δόλιοι βδέλυγμα ἐνώπιον Κυρίου, στάθμιον δὲ δίκαιον δεκτὸν αὐτῷ.

verses.geez: ኀበ፡ ሀሎ፡ ጽእለት፡ ህየ፡ ሀሎ፡ ኃሣር፡ አፈ፡ የዋሃንሰ፡ ይትሜሀር፡ ጥበበ።
verses.translation: Wherever pride enters, there will be also disgrace: but the mouth of the lowly meditates wisdom.

translations.lxx: Wherever pride enters, there will be also disgrace: but the mouth of the lowly meditates wisdom.
translations.kjv: When pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly is wisdom.
translations.ron: Dacă vine mândria, va veni şi ocara, iar înţelepciunea este cu cei smeriţi.
translations.grk: Οὗ ἐὰν εἰσέλθῃ ὕβρις, ἐκεῖ καὶ ἀτιμία· στόμα δὲ ταπεινῶν μελετᾷ σοφίαν.

verses.geez: ተፈጻሜቶሙ፡ ለጻድቃን፡ ትመርሖሙ፡ ወዕቅዐቶሙሰ፡ ለረሲዓን፡ ትፄውዎሙ።
verses.translation: When a just man dies he leaves regret: but the destruction of the ungodly is speedy, and causes joy.

translations.lxx: When a just man dies he leaves regret: but the destruction of the ungodly is speedy, and causes joy.
translations.kjv: The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.
translations.ron: Neprihănirea poartă pe cei drepţi, iar strâmbătatea prăpădeşte pe cei vicleni.
translations.grk: Ἀποθανὼν δίκαιος ἔλιπε μετάμελον, πρόχειρος δὲ γίνεται καὶ ἐπίχαρτος ἀσεβῶν ἀπώλεια.

verses.geez: ኢይበቊዕ፡ ናዋይ፡ በዕለተ፡ መዓት፡ ወጽድቅሰ፡ ታድኅን፡ እሞት፡ መዊቶ፡ ጻድቅ፡ ኀደገ፡ ንስሐ፡ ጉቡአን፡ በእድ፡ ይከውን፡ ወሰሐቀ፡ ሞቱ፡ ለረሲዕ።

translations.kjv: Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivereth from death.
translations.ron: La nimic nu foloseşte bogăţia în ziua mâniei; numai dreptatea izbăveşte de moarte.

verses.geez: ወጽድቁ፡ ለንጹሕ፡ ያረትዕ፡ ፍኖቶ፡ ወኃጢአትሰ፡ ትወርድ፡ ዲበ፡ ረሲዓን።
verses.translation: Righteousness traces out blameless paths: but ungodliness encounters unjust dealing.

translations.lxx: Righteousness traces out blameless paths: but ungodliness encounters unjust dealing.
translations.kjv: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
translations.ron: Dreptatea netezeşte calea celui fără prihană, iar cel fără de lege va cădea prin fărădelegea lui.
translations.grk: Δικαιοσύνη ἀμώμους ὀρθοτομεῖ ὁδοὺς, ἀσέβεια δὲ περιπίπτει ἀδικίᾳ.

verses.geez: ጽድቆሙ፡ ለራትዓን፡ ሰብእ፡ ትባልሖሙ፡ ወበኢያእምሮቶሙ፡ ይትአኀዙ፡ ኃጥአን።
verses.translation: The righteousness of upright men delivers them: but transgressors are caught in their own destruction.

translations.lxx: The righteousness of upright men delivers them: but transgressors are caught in their own destruction.
translations.kjv: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness.
translations.ron: Dreptatea izbăveşte pe cei drepţi, iar cei vicleni vor fi prinşi prin pofta lor.
translations.grk: Δικαιοσύνη ἀνδρῶν ὀρθῶν ῥύεται αὐτούς, τῇ δὲ ἀπωλείᾳ αὐτῶν ἁλίσκονται παράνομοι.

verses.geez: መዊቶ፡ ብእሲ፡ ጻድቅ፡ ኢየኀጒል፡ ተስፋሁ፡ ትምክሕቶሙሰ፡ ለረሲዓን፡ ትጠፍእ።
verses.translation: At the death of a just man his hope does not perish: but the boast of the ungodly perishes.

translations.lxx: At the death of a just man his hope does not perish: but the boast of the ungodly perishes.
translations.kjv: When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust men perisheth.
translations.ron: La moartea omului drept rămâne nădejdea, iar la moartea celui păcătos piere nădejdea.
translations.grk: Τελευτήσαντος ἀνδρὸς δικαίου, οὐκ ὄλλυται ἐλπίς, τὸ δὲ καύχημα τῶν ἀσεβῶν ὄλλυται.

verses.geez: ጻድቅሰ፡ እማዕገት፡ ያመሥጥ፡ ወቤዛ፡ ዚአሁ፡ ይትወሀብ፡ ረሲዕ።
verses.translation: A righteous man escapes from a snare, and the ungodly man is delivered up in his place.

translations.lxx: A righteous man escapes from a snare, and the ungodly man is delivered up in his place.
translations.kjv: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked cometh in his stead.
translations.ron: Dreptul scapă din strâmtorare, şi cel fără de lege îi ia locul.
translations.grk: Δίκαιος ἐκ θήρας ἐκδύνει, ἀντʼ αὐτοῦ δὲ παραδίδοται ὁ ἀσεβής.

verses.geez: ውስተ፡ አፈ፡ ረሲዓን፡ መሥገርት፡ ለሀገር፡ ወተዓውቆ፡ ጽድቅሰ፡ ፍኖት፡ ሠናይት።
verses.translation: In the mouth of ungodly men is a snare to citizens: but the understanding of righteous men is prosperous.

translations.lxx: In the mouth of ungodly men is a snare to citizens: but the understanding of righteous men is prosperous.
translations.kjv: An hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.
translations.ron: Făptuitorul de rele prăbuşeşte cu gura pe aproapele lui, iar prin ştiinţa celor drepţi va fi mântuit.
translations.grk: Ἐν στόματι ἀσεβῶν παγὶς πολίταις, αἴσθησις δὲ δικαίων εὔοδος.

verses.geez: በኂሩተ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ትረትዕ፡ ሀገር፡ ወበኃጒሎሙ፡ ለረሲዓን፡ ትትፌሣሕ።
verses.translation: In the prosperity of righteous men a city prospers:

translations.lxx: In the prosperity of righteous men a city prospers:
translations.kjv: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: and when the wicked perish, there is shouting.
translations.ron: De propăşirea celor drepţi cetatea se bucură, iar când pier cei fără de lege ea tresaltă de veselie.
translations.grk: Ἐν ἀγαθοῖς δικαίων κατώρθωσε πόλις,

verses.geez: በበረከቶሙ፡ ለራትዓን፡ ትትሌዓል፡ ሀገር፡ ወበአፉሆሙ፡ ለረሲዓን፡ ትትገፈታዕ።
verses.translation: but by the mouths of ungodly men it is overthrown.

translations.lxx: but by the mouths of ungodly men it is overthrown.
translations.kjv: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
translations.ron: Prin binecuvântarea oamenilor drepţi cetatea merge înainte, iar prin gura celor nelegiuiţi ajunge ruină.
translations.grk: στόμασι δὲ ἀσεβῶν κατεσκάφη.

verses.geez: ይሜንኑ፡ ሰብአ፡ ሀገር፡ ነዳየ፡ ጠቢበ፡ ወብእሲሰ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ጽማዌ፡ ያመጽእ።
verses.translation: A man void of understanding sneers at his fellow citizens: but a sensible man is quiet.

translations.lxx: A man void of understanding sneers at his fellow citizens: but a sensible man is quiet.
translations.kjv: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace.
translations.ron: Cel nepriceput urgiseşte pe aproapele lui, iar omul cu bună-chibzuială tace.
translations.grk: Μυκτηρίζει πολίτας ἐνδεὴς φρενῶν, ἀνὴρ δὲ φρόνιμος ἡσυχίαν ἄγει.

verses.geez: ብእሲ፡ ዘክልኤ፡ ልሳኑ፡ ይከሥት፡ ምክረ፡ ማኅበር፡ ወምእመነ፡ እስትንፋስሰ፡ የኀብእ፡ ምክረ።
verses.translation: A double-tongued man discloses the secret counsels of an assembly: but he that is faithful in spirit conceals matters.

translations.lxx: A double-tongued man discloses the secret counsels of an assembly: but he that is faithful in spirit conceals matters.
translations.kjv: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.
translations.ron: Grăitorul de rele dă pe faţă lucruri de taină, iar omul cu duhul cumpănit le ţine ascunse.
translations.grk: Ἀνὴρ δίγλωσσος ἀποκαλύπτει βουλὰς ἐν συνεδρίῳ, πιστὸς δὲ πνοῇ κρύπτει πράγματα.

verses.geez: እለ፡ አልቦሙ፡ ኃዳፍ፡ ይትነገፉ፡ ከመ፡ ቈጽል፡ መድኃኒት፡ በብዙኅ፡ ምክር፡ ይሄሉ።
verses.translation: They that have no guidance fall like leaves: but in much counsel there is safety.

translations.lxx: They that have no guidance fall like leaves: but in much counsel there is safety.
translations.kjv: Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.
translations.ron: Unde lipseşte cârmuirea, poporul cade; izbăvirea stă în mulţimea sfetnicilor.
translations.grk: Οἷς μὴ ὑπάρχει κυβέρνησις, πίπτουσιν ὥσπερ φύλλα, σωτηρία δὲ ὑπάρχει ἐν πολλῇ βουλῇ.

verses.geez: እኩይ፡ የአኪ፡ ሶበ፡ ይዴመር፡ ምስለ፡ ጻድቅ፡ ወይጸልእ፡ ድምፀ፡ ዑቃቤ።
verses.translation: A bad man does harm wherever he meets a just man: and he hates the sound of safety.

translations.lxx: A bad man does harm wherever he meets a just man: and he hates the sound of safety.
translations.kjv: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: and he that hateth suretiship is sure.
translations.ron: Celui ce se pune chezaş pentru un străin îi merge rău; cel ce nu se pune chezaş stă la adăpost.
translations.grk: Πονηρὸς κακοποιεῖ ὅταν συνμίξῃ δικαίῳ, μισεῖ δὲ ἦχον ἀσφαλείας.

verses.geez: ብእሲት፡ ኄርት፡ ታነሥእ፡ ክብረ፡ ለምታ፡ ብእሲትሰ፡ እንተ፡ ትጸልእ፡ ጽድቀ፡ መንበረ፡ ኃሣር፡ ይእቲ።
verses.translation: A gracious wife brings glory to her husband: but a woman hating righteousness is a theme of dishonour. The slothful come to want: but the diligent support themselves with wealth.

translations.lxx: A gracious wife brings glory to her husband: but a woman hating righteousness is a theme of dishonour. The slothful come to want: but the diligent support themselves with wealth.
translations.kjv: A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong men retain riches.
translations.ron: Femeia cu purtare bună agoniseşte cinstire, iar cea care urăşte cinstea e o ruşine. Nu leneşii ci silitorii agonisesc avere.
translations.grk: Γυνὴ εὐχάριστος ἐγείρει ἀνδρὶ δόξαν, θρόνος δὲ ἀτιμίας γυνὴ μισοῦσα δίκαια· πλούτου ὀκνηροὶ ἐνδεεῖς γίνονται, οἱ δὲ ἀνδρεῖοι ἐρείδονται πλούτῳ.

verses.geez: ሀካይያን፡ እምብዕል፡ ይነድዩ፡ ወፅኑዓንሰ፡ ይዴግኑ፡ ብዕለ።
verses.translation: A merciful man does good to his own soul: but the merciless destroys his own body.

translations.lxx: A merciful man does good to his own soul: but the merciless destroys his own body.
translations.kjv: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.
translations.ron: Omul milostiv îşi face bine sufletului său, pe când cel fără milă îşi chinuieşte trupul său.
translations.grk: Τῇ ψυχῇ αὐτοῦ ἀγαθὸν ποιεῖ ἀνὴρ ἐλεήμων, ἐξολλύει δὲ αὐτοῦ σῶμα ὁ ἀνελεήμων.

verses.geez: ለነፍሱ፡ ይገብር፡ ሠናየ፡ ብእሲ፡ መሐሪ፡ ወያማስን፡ ሥጋሁ፡ ዘኢይምሕር።
verses.translation: An ungodly man performs unrighteous works: but the seed of the righteous is a reward of truth.

translations.lxx: An ungodly man performs unrighteous works: but the seed of the righteous is a reward of truth.
translations.kjv: The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward.
translations.ron: Cel nelegiuit capătă un câştig înşelător, iar cel ce seamănă dreptatea, o răsplată adevărată.
translations.grk: Ἀσεβὴς ποιεῖ ἔργα ἄδικα, σπέρμα δὲ δικαίων μισθὸς ἀληθείας.

verses.geez: ረሲዕ፡ ይገብር፡ ምግባረ፡ ዓመፃ፡ ወለዘርአ፡ ጻድቃንሰ፡ ዐስብ፡ ህልው።
verses.translation: A righteous son is born for life: but the persecution of the ungodly ends in death.

translations.lxx: A righteous son is born for life: but the persecution of the ungodly ends in death.
translations.kjv: As righteousness tendeth to life: so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death.
translations.ron: Cel ce umblă după dreptate ajunge la viaţă, iar cel ce fuge după rău, la moarte.
translations.grk: Υἱὸς δίκαιος γεννᾶται εἰς ζωὴν, διωγμὸς δὲ ἀσεβοῦς εἰς θάνατον.

verses.geez: ወልደ፡ ጻድቅ፡ ይትወለድ፡ ለሕይወት፡ ወልደተ፡ ረሲዓንሰ፡ ለሞት።
verses.translation: Perverse ways are an abomination to the Lord: but all they that are blameless in their ways are acceptable to him.

translations.lxx: Perverse ways are an abomination to the Lord: but all they that are blameless in their ways are acceptable to him.
translations.kjv: They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the LORD: but such as are upright in their way are his delight.
translations.ron: Pe cei cu inima vicleană îi urgiseşte Domnul; plăcerea Lui este spre cei fără prihană.
translations.grk: Βδέλυγμα Κυρίῳ διεστραμμέναι ὁδοὶ, προσδεκτοὶ δὲ αὐτῷ πάντες ἄμωμοι ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: ርኩሳት፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ፍናው፡ ጠዋያት፡ ወኅሩያን፡ በቅድሜሁ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ ንጹሐን፡ በፍኖቶሙ።
verses.translation: He that unjustly strikes hands shall not be unpunished: but he that sows righteousness shall receive a faithful reward.

translations.lxx: He that unjustly strikes hands shall not be unpunished: but he that sows righteousness shall receive a faithful reward.
translations.kjv: Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.
translations.ron: Încetul cu încetul păcătosul nu va rămâne nepedepsit, iar neamul celor drepţi va fi mântuit.
translations.grk: Χειρὶ χεῖρας ἐμβαλὼν ἀδίκως οὐκ ἀτιμώρητος ἔσται, ὁ δὲ σπείρων δικαιοσύνην λήψεται μισθὸν πιστόν.

verses.geez: እደ፡ በእድ፡ ዘይእኅዝ፡ በግፍዕ፡ ኢይድኅን፡ እምኃጢአት፡ ወዘይዘርእሰ፡ ጽድቀ፡ ዐስበ፡ መሀይምናን፡ ይነሥእ።
verses.translation: As an ornament in a swine's snout, so is beauty to an ill-minded woman.

translations.lxx: As an ornament in a swine's snout, so is beauty to an ill-minded woman.
translations.kjv: As a jewel of gold in a swine’s snout, so is a fair woman which is without discretion.
translations.ron: Inel de aur în râtul porcului, aşa este femeia frumoasă şi fără minte.
translations.grk: Ὥσπερ ἐνώτιον ἐν ῥινὶ ὑός, οὕτως γυναικὶ κακόφρονι κάλλος.

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ውዕቦ፡ ወርቅ፡ ውስተ፡ ጽንፈ፡ አንፈ፡ ሐራውያ፡ ኅሡም፡ ከማሁ፡ ላህያ፡ ለብእሲት፡ እኪት።
verses.translation: All the desire of the righteous is good: but the hope of the ungodly shall perish.

translations.lxx: All the desire of the righteous is good: but the hope of the ungodly shall perish.
translations.kjv: The desire of the righteous is only good: but the expectation of the wicked is wrath.
translations.ron: Dorinţa celor drepţi este bine; nădejdea celor fără de lege este mânia lui Dumnezeu.
translations.grk: Ἐπιθυμία δικαίων πᾶσα ἀγαθὴ, ἐλπὶς δὲ ἀσεβῶν ἀπολεῖται.

verses.geez: ፍኖተ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሠናይ፡ ተስፋሆሙሰ፡ ለረሲዓን፡ ይትኀጐል።
verses.translation: There are some who scatter their own, and make it more: and there are some also who gather, yet have less.

translations.lxx: There are some who scatter their own, and make it more: and there are some also who gather, yet have less.
translations.kjv: There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth to poverty.
translations.ron: Unul dă mereu şi se îmbogăţeşte, altul se zgârceşte afară din cale şi sărăceşte.
translations.grk: Εἰσὶν, οἳ τὰ ἴδια σπείροντες πλείονα ποιοῦσιν· εἰσὶδέ καὶ οἳ συνάγοντες ἐλαττονοῦνται.

verses.geez: ቦ፡ እላ፡ ዘዚአሆሙ፡ ይዘርኡ፡ ወያፈደፍዱ፡ ወቦ፡ እለ፡ እንዘ፡ ያስተጋብኡ፡ የሐፅፁ።
verses.translation: Every sincere soul is blessed: but a passionate man is not graceful.

translations.lxx: Every sincere soul is blessed: but a passionate man is not graceful.
translations.kjv: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
translations.ron: Cel ce binecuvintează va fi îndestulat, iar cel ce blesteamă va fi blestemat.
translations.grk: Ψυχὴ εὐλογουμένη πᾶσα ἁπλῇ, ἀνὴρ δὲ θυμώδης οὐκ εὐσχήμων.

verses.geez: ወኵላ፡ ነፍስ፡ እንተ፡ ትትባረክ፡ ስፍሕት፡ ወብእሲሰ፡ መዓትም፡ ሕ
verses.translation: May he that hoards corn leave it to the nation: but blessing be on the head of him that gives it.

translations.lxx: May he that hoards corn leave it to the nation: but blessing be on the head of him that gives it.
translations.kjv: He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.
translations.ron: Cel ce ţine grâul este blestemat de popor, iar binecuvântarea (se revarsă) peste capul celui ce îl vinde.
translations.grk: Ὁ συνέχων σῖτον ὑπολείποιτο αὐτὸν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν· εὐλογία δὲ εἰς κεφαλὴν τοῦ μεταδιδόντος.

verses.geez: ዘያበዝኅ፡ ሥርናዮ፡ የኃድጎ፡ ለአሕዛብ፡ ወይረግምዎ፡ ነዳያን፡ ወበረከት፡ ውስተ፡ ርእሱ፡ ለዘይምሕር፡ ወይሁብ።
verses.translation: He that devises good counsels seeks good favour: but as for him that seeks after evil, evil shall overtake him.

translations.lxx: He that devises good counsels seeks good favour: but as for him that seeks after evil, evil shall overtake him.
translations.kjv: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.
translations.ron: Cel ce caută binele dobândeşte bunăvoinţa Domnului, iar cel ce umblă după rău va da peste el.
translations.grk: Τεκταινόμενος ἀγαθὰ ζητεῖ χάριν ἀγαθὴν, ἐκζητοῦντα δὲ κακὰ καταλήψεται αὐτόν.

verses.geez: ዘይሔሊ፡ ሠናየ፡ ይፈቅድ፡ ክብረ፡ ሠናየ፡ ወዘሰ፡ የኃሥሣ፡ ለእኪት፡ ትረክቦ።
verses.translation: He that trusts in wealth shall fall; but he that helps righteous men shall rise.

translations.lxx: He that trusts in wealth shall fall; but he that helps righteous men shall rise.
translations.kjv: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall; but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.
translations.ron: Cel ce-şi pune nădejdea în bogăţia lui se veştejeşte, iar cei drepţi ca frunzişul odrăslesc.
translations.grk: Ὁ πεποιθὼς ἐπὶ πλούτῳ οὗτος πεσεῖται, ὁ δὲ ἀντιλαμβανόμενος δικαίων οὗτος ἀνατελεῖ.

verses.geez: ዘይትወከል፡ በብዕሉ፡ ውእቱ፡ ይወድቅ፡ ወዘይትዌከፎሙሰ፡ ለጻድቃን፡ ይሠርዕ።
verses.translation: He that deals not graciously with his own house shall inherit the wind; and the fool shall be servant to the wise man.

translations.lxx: He that deals not graciously with his own house shall inherit the wind; and the fool shall be servant to the wise man.
translations.kjv: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart.
translations.ron: Cine îşi tulbură casa lui culege vânt, iar cel nebun va fi sluga celui înţelept.
translations.grk: Ὁ μὴ συμπεριφερόμενος τῷ ἑαυτοῦ οἴκῳ, κληρονομήσει ἄνεμον, δουλεύσει δὲ ἄφρων φρονίμῳ.

verses.geez: ዘኢየዓውቅ፡ ቤቶ፡ ይወርሶ፡ ነፋስ፡ ወይትቀነይ፡ ዓብድ፡ ለጠቢብ።
verses.translation: Out of the fruit of righteousness grows a tree of life; but the souls of transgressors are cut off before their time.

translations.lxx: Out of the fruit of righteousness grows a tree of life; but the souls of transgressors are cut off before their time.
translations.kjv: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls is wise.
translations.ron: Rodul dreptăţii este un pom al vieţii, iar silnicia nimiceşte viaţa.
translations.grk: Ἐκ καρποῦ δικαιοσύνης φύεται δένδρὅν ζωῆς, ἀφαιροῦνται δὲ ἄωροι ψυχαὶ παρανόμων.

verses.geez: እምፍሬ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ይወጽእ፡ ዕፀ፡ ሕይወት፡ ወይሴስላ፡ ግብተ፡ ነፍሳተ፡ ዓማፅያን።
verses.translation: If the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?

translations.lxx: If the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?
translations.kjv: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.
translations.ron: Dacă cel drept este răsplătit pe pământ, cu cât mai mult cel nelegiuit şi păcătos!
translations.grk: Εἰ ὁ μὲν δίκαιος μόλις σώζεται, ὁ ἀσεβὴς καὶ ἁμαρτωλὸς ποῦ φανεῖται;

verses.geez: ወሶበ፡ ጻድቅ፡ እምዕፁብ፡ ይድኅን፡ ረሲዕ፡ ወኃጥእ፡ ወዓማፂ፡ በአይቴ፡ ያስተርኢ።
